problem: get_columns() reads a column's server default from SHOW COLUMNS, which prints a string default without its quotes: DEFAULT 'it''s' reflects as it''s, '' as an empty string and the string 'NULL' as NULL, a date in display format, and the string 'CURRENT_USER' the same as the USER function. title: Reflect string and date server defaults as quoted SQL literals
